header: The shelf of proven questions under the Executive Deep Search button (src/components/EdsExamples.tsx): every question the project has tried on EDS and found to reach it as typed, grouped by what each one teaches. A signed-in executive who presses the button sees this shelf in the window; pressing a question runs it. I do not write the QUESTIONS here: they are the guide's own (TEST_QUERIES in src/lib/help/edsGuide.ts: the panel, the gold set, the fresh set and the corrected forms, 9 to 12 November 2026, each scored by the real detector in edsGuide.selftest), so the guide and the shelf can never disagree. This file only says how they are grouped and in what order, and adds what the guide does not hold: a question put in plain words (A-C3 of eval/router-acceptance.json: verified on screen, 18 Oct 2026). Every circular a question needs was checked against the database on 23 Nov 2026. The shelf's four types are the four groups of KEYWORDS below (same titles, same order). For a new proven question, add it to TEST_QUERIES, then name its id in ONE type (TYPES); edsExamples.selftest fails until every question is in exactly one. Keep this file free of server-only imports: it is drawn in the browser.

doc: The "finding what is hidden" questions, written for this shelf on 23 Nov 2026: each was run through the real engine (the same retrieval, writer and checker as the app) on circulars that are in the database, and every claim in its note was checked against the circular's own text. The wording is the one that was run: do not reword one without running it again (that happened with H01: a more neutral wording, tried on 23 Nov 2026, missed the very slips the question exists to show). The note says what the question found when it was tried.

symbols.name: KeywordGroup
doc: The keywords: the words the browser's own rules (src/lib/search/synthesisIntent.ts: no AI, no wait) score when a question is typed in the ordinary box. 5 points make a deep question. Each group says what its words are worth and how to complete them; edsExamples.selftest scores a probe sentence for every word with the real detector, so this list cannot drift from the rules.

members.name: how
doc: What a word of this group does on its own, and what finishes the job

members.name: probe
doc: A short sentence that uses ONE word of the group (the selftest scores it with the others' words left out); {w} is the word

members.name: alone
doc: true means a word of this group is enough alone (5 points); false means it is worth 3 and needs one more clue

symbols.type: { id: string; blurb: string; ids: string[]; templates?: string[] }[]
doc: The four types of the shelf are the four groups of keywords above, in the same order and under the same titles: I file a question under the type of the keyword it is built on. A question with no listed keyword (it reaches EDS by its shape: years, "and which", a list after a colon) I file by what it asks. The "hidden" type's questions (H01-H08) were written and tried for this shelf on 23 Nov 2026 (see HIDDEN); N01-N06 were tried the same day (see TRIED).
